explanation: The downstream job appears to preserve the upstream provenance order it was given, but that handoff is already faulty. The corpus/needs show n06-r01 has demand_score 9 and n06-r08 has demand_score 3, yet the evidence_sources handoff ranks n06-r08 as rank 1 and n06-r01 as rank 8. The captured assemble_provenance implementation sorts by demand_score ascending, which explains the inverted provenance order and the downstream recommendation of n06-r07 over the higher-demand unsupported n06-r01.
